description: Public 2026 Maryland general election polls, used only as a cross-check on the forecast.

sources.polls: hand-maintained; rows are added by hand from published poll releases, one row per poll, with source_url

notes: Created header-only by 01_build_inputs.R; the script never overwrites an existing file, so hand-entered rows are kept. Rows entered by hand on 2026-10-17 from public releases: the UMBC Poll (Sept 22-27, 2026, 776 likely voters; party composition from the release's unweighted 'Other Sample Demographics' table) and Zenith Research (July 27-Aug 3, 2026, 800 likely voters, a partisan-client poll; toplines from Wikipedia's 2026 Maryland gubernatorial election polling table because the cited Maryland Matters article returned HTTP 403). Only these two general-election polls were found. Used only as a cross-check on the forecast's implied party composition, never as a model input.
